asked: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Hub /projects folder is mounted The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-axhub-projects-dir` (service data, status warn) - What it says: AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR isn't set - How the fix failed: There's nothing Brett has to do himself here, just start this fix from an axHub-connected session. The warning stays until then. The permanent fix (having `install-console.sh` set this env var and mount the volume, like the `AXF_PUBLIC_URL` fix) is still waiting on Brett's go. Details: - Shared data (pending list, build queue, changes log) is read from the hub's /projects; without it the console falls back to stale repo copies. - env {"name": "AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR"} How it's fixed by hand: - Mount the axhub-projects volume in the console's Coolify app and set AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR=/projects. - Redeploy the console. Rules: - Fix only this check. Change nothing unrelated; never delete data, volumes, containers or other people's files. - Never print, copy or commit secrets (tokens, keys, .env files, .axf-console/). - Code changes go on this worktree's branch only: commit and push the branch, never main, never merge. - When done, refresh the host report: `bash /opt/axf/deploy/console-doctor.sh --report`. - Record steps and the result on your change-log entry (the hooks do most of it; `changes.mjs step|result last …`). - You may run shell commands on the VPS (you run as root): prefer the smallest, reversible change.
